quarterly_data.quarter: Maxio Technology results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual (04-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chairman Fang Xiaoling (2025 annual results briefing): the new-generation automotive perception signal processing chip, which integrates the company's own digital signal processing unit and an on-device AI acceleration engine for advanced driver-assistance upgrades, has passed AEC-Q100 automotive reliability qualification and is in mass production, with supplier nominations from mainstream domestic carmakers; the company is expanding to more carmakers. Its AIoT SoC chips are widely used in cameras, industrial PCs, smart gateways, conference cameras, LED display receiver cards, set-top boxes and switches.
